results.title: Export duty on diesel hiked ₹2.5/litre, ATF ₹1.5/litre, petrol remains nil
results.content: The hike in diesel levy assumes added significance as India looks to further up their exports of the vehicular fuel to Europe amid a global supply crunch.

results.title: No proof from ECI to show SIR was a ‘unanimous’ decision, Rahul Gandhi to Supreme Court
results.content: The ECI’s October 26 affidavit, in response to a petition filed by INDIA bloc leaders led by Mr. Gandhi, denied any differences of opinion between the CEC and the Election Commissioners over the SIR process

results.content: Bishop of Calcutta Reverend Paritosh Canning ruled out claims of religious conversion by institutions affiliated with the Churches of North India

results.title: India’s equity market: The cost of taxation, policy uncertainty and lost investor confidence
results.content: Investor confidence, once weakened by a series of inconsistent or costly policy decisions, cannot be restored by optimism alone

results.title: Clear the path: On SCO Civilisational Dialogue Forum in New Delhi
results.content: India should use multilateral fora to advance bilateral cooperation

results.title: Paharganj building collapse: Police book contractor, owner for negligence, MCD says no construction work underway
results.content: Delhi Police apprehended two people after an under-construction Paharganj hotel collapsed, injuring eight workers; MCD said no construction was underway at the time despite GRAP restrictions

results.title: Delhi’s construction boom, workers’ growing risks: Safety takes a back seat as violations go unchecked
results.content: Missing helmets and protective gear, unsafe structures, punishing work hours and rushed construction expose a deepening safety crisis at Delhi’s building sites, where basic safeguards are routinely ignored and accountability often comes only after tragedy strikes

results.title: A poverty line that falls short
results.content: Reliable poverty estimates are not just for academic purposes. India has made real progress, but without a credible benchmark, it is hard to say how much, or how much remains to be done

results.title: ‘ISKCON’, ‘Tantric’, ‘Gorak Nath’: 287 ‘other’ religions briefly listed on Census portal
results.content: The drop-down menu under the ‘Others’ category in the question pertaining to the respondent’s religion had 287 options for those not choosing from among the six major religions in India. After The Hindu raised a query about the classification, the drop-down menu was removed from the portal.

results.title: Sonia’s memoir ‘Belonging’ debuts with 2 lakh copies sold in under a week: HarperCollins India CEO
results.content: The thunderous response to the book has clearly taken even the debut author by surprise, with Sonia Gandhi admitting that she is “overwhelmed” by the outpouring of love and affection from readers

results.title: Plea in SC says ghost Form 7s haunt Mustafabad constituency during Delhi SIR
results.content: The petition said persons declared dead were alive, while persons said to have shifted were found at home. Thirty-seven applications examined by the authorities were found to be false or fabricated.
